scores.notes: Alice is a young girl with long light-brown hair, fair skin, yellow dress with white apron and blue sash, striped stockings in both; hair is wavier with a headband on the left, straighter on the right, but colour, length, age and face agree.

Both show pale limestone flat-roofed buildings with dry-stone walls among olive-dotted terraced hills with cypresses under the same cloudy daylight; left is a close courtyard view, right a distant view of the compound from the road, buildings look taller on the left but compatible.

Jesus on the left is a tiny distant figure on the cross on the hilltop, face and hair not legible; on the right he is a small long-haired bearded figure on the water. Too small on the left to judge identity.

Daniel (left foreground looking up; right standing among the lions) is an older lean man with short grey hair, short grey beard and tan skin in both, wearing the same blue mantle over a cream robe with a shoulder satchel.

Daniel (left being lifted from the pit; right front-right of the crowd facing the throne) has short grey hair, grey beard, lean older face and tan skin in both, with the same blue mantle, cream robe and satchel.

Watson (left seated in brown tweed; right standing in the background in bowler and dark overcoat) has the same brown moustache, squarish middle-aged face and sturdy build; hair mostly hidden by the hat on the right and he is small there, but nothing conflicts.
Holmes (left examining the hat with a lens; right seated in the armchair with steepled fingers) has the same gaunt clean-shaven face, hawk nose, high forehead and dark swept-back hair in both.

Peter (left the net-carrying man clasping the beggar's hand; right the man leaping from the boat) has dark curly greying hair, a short dark-grey beard, tan skin and the same brown robe with a net over the shoulder in both.

Watson (left in brown suit and bowler holding a bag; right in dark coat and bowler with bag) has the same full brown moustache, ruddy middle-aged face and sturdy build; he is small and looks a little stouter on the left but no cue conflicts.

Alice (left standing before the court; right holding the bottle) is the same young girl with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin and round face, in the same yellow dress, white apron, blue sash and striped stockings.

Watson (left seated in the carriage; right lying on the bed shading his eyes) has brown side-parted hair and a brown moustache with a similar ruddy middle-aged face in both; his arm hides part of the face on the right but visible cues agree.

Peter (left the man clutching his chest at the courtyard's left; right the dripping-wet man at centre by the fire) has dark curly greying hair, a short greying beard, tan skin and the same brown mantle over a pale tunic in both.

Watson (left seated behind the bed in the dark room; right standing in bowler with medical bag) has a dark-brown moustache, short dark hair and sturdy build in both; he looks somewhat older and heavier-faced in the dim left image but no clear cue conflicts.

Holmes on the left (armchair) has a full head of dark swept-back hair and a gaunt hollow-cheeked face; Holmes on the right (at the door beside Watson) is bald across the top with hair only at the sides and a softer, fuller face. Hairline conflicts.

Alice (left holding the flamingo; right facing the caterpillar) has long straight light-brown hair, fair skin, the same child's age and build, and the same yellow dress, white apron, blue sash and striped stockings.

Both show a daylit croquet lawn enclosed by rounded clipped hedges with tall trees and clusters of giant mushrooms at the edge, hoops, hedgehogs and flamingos on the grass; hoop style and hedge tint differ slightly but the place is compatible.
Holmes (left seated with pipe reading by the lamp; right striking at the bell-rope with a cane) has the same gaunt clean-shaven face, sharp nose and dark slicked-back hair in both.

Both show a sunny garden croquet lawn with playing-card arches, hedgehogs, tall trees and giant mushrooms at the right edge; left boundary is a masonry wall with topiary and the right a tall hedge, which a different viewpoint of one garden could explain.

Peter (left the man with staff and net raising the beggar; right the man stepping from the boat onto the water) has dark curly hair, a short dark greying beard, tan weathered face and sturdy build in both; slightly more grey on the left only.
Holmes (left in shirtsleeves lashing at the snake; right seated with pipe by the fire) has the same gaunt clean-shaven face, sharp nose and dark slicked-back hair with a high forehead in both.

Both show a white two-storey country house with red tiled roof and tall chimneys burning at night, set back on a lawn behind a gravel drive lined with hedges, with fire engines at the right and bare trees around; roof gable details and backdrop (woods vs open fields) differ slightly but compatibly.

Both show a long tea table set under a large spreading tree on grass in front of a pale clapboard house with a porch, in the same daylight; the table has a cloth on the right and bare wood on the left, but the place itself matches.
Holmes (left with lens and pipe on the street; right flinging the paper ball in the carriage) has the same lean clean-shaven face, sharp nose and dark swept-back hair in both.

Daniel (left standing among the lions; right foreground looking at the sky) has short grey hair, a short grey beard, tan skin and lean older build in both, with the same blue mantle over a cream robe.

Left shows a dirt road through olive-dotted terraced hills with dry-stone walls leading to a distant cluster of pale flat-roofed stone buildings; right shows a close view of pale flat-roofed stone buildings with a dry-stone wall, olive trees and the same terraced hills in daylight. Compatible views of one place.
Holmes (left holding the lens over the hat; right in shirtsleeves striking at the snake) has the same gaunt clean-shaven face, sharp nose, high forehead and dark slicked-back hair in both.

Moses (left seated on the stone with arms raised; right raising the staff at the rock) is an elderly man with white hair, a full white beard and tan weathered face in both, in a brown mantle over a pale robe; hair is a little longer on the left.

Daniel (left foreground at the left edge with satchel watching the throne; right standing in the den with open hands) has short grey hair, a short grey beard and tan skin in both, with the same blue mantle, pale robe and shoulder satchel.

Watson (left sitting up in bed shading his eyes; right standing with folded arms in a waistcoat) has brown side-parted hair and a brown moustache in both; he is small and partly covered by his hand on the left and looks burlier on the right, but no cue conflicts.
Holmes (left standing with pipe by the railings, small; right seated with steepled fingers) has a gaunt clean-shaven face, sharp nose and dark swept-back hair in both.

Moses (left seated on the rock with arms held up; right standing with a staff beside the priest) is an elderly man with white hair, a full white beard and tan lined face in both, in a dark brown mantle over a pale robe; hair is fuller on the left and thinner on top on the right, but age, beard and face agree.
Peter (left wading ashore in a wet tunic; right leaping from the boat in a brown cloak) has curly dark-grey hair, a short grey beard, tan weathered face and muscular build in both.
Holmes (left bent over the hat with a lens; right standing with lens and pipe) has the same gaunt clean-shaven face, sharp nose, high forehead and dark swept-back hair in both.

David (left the youth dodging the spear; right the youth picking stones from the brook) is a slim clean-shaven teenager with short dark curly hair and tan skin in both, in the same rough brown tunic with a shoulder bag.

Moses (left seated between the two men with arms held up; right walking at the front right with a staff) is an elderly man with white hair and a full white beard in both, in a brown mantle over a pale robe; smaller on the right but face and hair are legible.

Both show a circular pit lined with large grey ashlar blocks holding lions, open to daylight with the king's party at the rim; left is seen from outside with city walls behind, right from inside looking up. The right shows an arched overhang not visible on the left, but the stonework and round shape are compatible.

Moses (left seated on the stone between two men; right raising the rod beside the gushing rock) is an elderly man with white hair, a full white beard and tan lined face in both, in a dark brown mantle over a pale robe.

Watson (left standing with medical bag in the street; right seated in the carriage) wears a bowler in both and has the same brown moustache, short brown hair at the sides, squarish middle-aged face and sturdy build.

Daniel (left pointing before the king; right foreground looking up at the sky) has short grey hair, a short grey beard, lean older face and tan skin in both, with the same blue mantle, pale robe and cylindrical shoulder case.

Holmes (left tossing the paper ball in the carriage; right standing with pipe by the railings, small) is a tall lean clean-shaven man with dark swept-back hair and a sharp-nosed narrow face in both; face looks a little gaunter on the right but no cue conflicts.

Moses (left seen in profile from behind stretching his staff over the sea; right swinging the staff at the rock) is an elderly man with white hair and a long white beard in both, in a brown mantle over a pale robe; the left face is in part-profile but hair, beard and age agree.

Both show a dark cellar of brick vaulted arches on thick brick piers with a flagstone floor and stacked wooden crates, lit by a single lantern; the right looks down a longer vaulted passage, a compatible viewpoint.

Both show the same open circular pit lined with large grey ashlar blocks with a sandy floor and a flat stone rim on bare dry ground under a pale sky; the left also shows a barred gate, steps and a compound wall with palms on its far side while the right looks out over open ground, which opposite viewpoints could explain.

The Cheshire Cat (left floating behind Alice and the Queen; right crouched on the branch) is a striped tabby with dark stripes, pale muzzle, yellow-green eyes and a wide toothy grin in both; fur reads slightly browner on the left and greyer on the right.

Moses (left pointing at the pig with a crook; right leading the crowd through the sea with a staff) is an elderly man with white hair and a full white beard in both, in a brown mantle over a pale robe with a dark sash; smaller on the right but legible.

Holmes (left holding the lens over the hat; right tapping the pavement with his stick, in a bowler) has the same gaunt clean-shaven face with sharp nose and hollow cheeks and a tall thin build; the hat hides most of his hair on the right and he is small, but visible cues agree.

Watson (left lying on the bed shading his eyes; right standing in brown suit and bowler with bag) has a reddish-brown moustache and ruddy face in both; his arm covers part of the face on the left and he is small with hair under a hat on the right, but nothing conflicts.
Holmes (left seated with steepled fingers by the fire; right holding up the paper ball in the carriage) has the same lean clean-shaven face, sharp nose and dark swept-back hair in both.

Moses (left the white-haired man with the staff at the front centre of the crowd; right raising the crook at the rock) is an elderly man with white hair and a full white beard in both, in a brown mantle over a pale robe; a second similar elder stands beside him on the left but the staff singles him out.

Watson (left seated in the armchair facing Holmes; right seated behind the bed in the dark room) has short brown side-parted hair, a brown moustache, a broad ruddy middle-aged face and sturdy build in both.

Jesus (left pointing toward the tomb; right standing on the water) has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard and tan skin in both, in a pale robe with a blue mantle; smaller on the right but legible.

Alice (left cradling the flamingo; right holding the bottle) is the same young girl with long light-brown hair, fair skin and round face, in the same yellow dress, white apron, blue sash and striped stockings; hair is a little wavier on the left.

Moses (left walking at the front with a crook; right standing on the rock with arms spread, seen partly from behind) is an elderly man with white hair and a white beard in both, in a dark mantle over a pale robe with a crook; the right face is in part-profile and small, but hair, beard and age agree.
